reasoning_content: I see there's a duplicate start - there's both the tsx cli and another node process on port 3000. Let me kill the old one properly and restart cleanly.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Kill all node processes
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("kill -9 3298528 3298544 3298557 2>/dev/null; true")

time.sleep(3)

# Start fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && nohup npx tsx src/index.ts > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &")

time.sleep(25)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
